display_names.en_US: Fusion timing (0 current, 1 legacy replay, 2 delayed primary)
display_names.zh_CN: 融合时序（0 当前，1 历史回放，2 滞后主滤波）

description.en_US: Mode 2 is experimental: a delayed primary plus an independent complete present state/covariance predictor. Exact replay requires horizon request/status and original body/step/initial-state streams. Hardware timing and flight qualification are unproven.
description.zh_CN: 模式 2 为实验功能：滞后主滤波配合独立的完整当前状态及协方差预测。精确回放需要时域请求/状态以及原始输入、步骤和初始化记录；硬件时序及飞行资格尚未验证。

display_names.zh_CN: 主滤波滞后长度（毫秒）

description.en_US: Used only by timing mode 2. The primary runs behind input present; an independent complete state and covariance predictor supplies present output. Configured rates and fixed queue capacity must be reviewed.
description.zh_CN: 仅用于时序模式 2。主滤波落后于当前输入，独立的完整状态与协方差预测器提供当前输出；需核对配置速率与固定队列容量。

display_names.zh_CN: 启用实验性 GNSS 重捕获（0/1）

description.en_US: Disabled by default. Enabling requires an explicit complete experimental policy; no hardware or flight qualification.
description.zh_CN: 默认关闭；零值为未配置占位，不是已批准的飞行参数。启用前必须填写完整、经过审查的实验配置；硬件与飞行验证未完成。
